caption: Security Control Rule
description: The Security Control Rule object describes a rule used by a security control to observe activity, detect threats or policy violations, or enforce security policy. It includes the rule's identity, configuration, and match context. Examples of security controls include firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, network proxies, and endpoint protection systems.
name: firewall_rule

condition.description: The rule trigger condition for the rule. For example: SQL_INJECTION.

desc.description: The description of the security control rule.

duration.description: The rule response time duration, usually used for challenge completion time.

name.description: The name of the security control rule.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the security control rule.
